# Municipal Ordinance No. KauBayanBlg01S2000, Series of 2000

**An Ordinance Regulating Fishing Activities, Fish Sanctuaries, and Other Related Activities in the Municipal Waters of Pitogo, Quezon, and Providing Penalties for Violations (Kautusang Pambayan Blg. 01, Serye ng Taong 2000)**

## Summary

This ordinance comprehensively regulates fishing activities, fish sanctuaries, aquatic resource management, and related activities in the municipal waters of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], Quezon. It establishes a licensing and permit system, prescribes fees for various types of fishing gear, delineates fishing zones and fish sanctuary areas, lists prohibited fishing methods, establishes penalties for violations, and creates the Pitogo Municipal Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Management Council (FARMC).

## Key Provisions

**Section 1 — Short Title.** Known as the "Kautusang Bayan ng Pitogo" — the municipal fisheries ordinance.

**Section 2 — Scope.** Covers the municipal waters of Pitogo, Quezon, including waters within 15 kilometers from the coastline extending to the barangays of Mabayo and the adjacent areas.

**Section 3 — License/Permit and Fees.** Any person or entity engaging in commercial or non-commercial fishing or videoke machine operations shall secure the following:
- A. Mayor's Permit
- B. Tax payment as established

### Schedule of Fees for Fishing Gear (Used in All Areas):

| Fishing Gear | Fee |
|-------------|-----|
| Anod (Floating Amod) | P 100.00 |
| Largarete | P 100.00 |
| Lambog-lambog (Surp, Gill Net) | P 100.00 |
| Baby Banig (Galasa na 3 knotalos, not less than 3 cm mesh net) | P 300.00 |

### Schedule of Fees for Gear Used in Rivers:

| Fishing Gear | Fee |
|-------------|-----|
| Bobo (malaki) | P 30.00 |
| Bobo (maliit) | P 20.00 |
| Bukatot padarso | P 200.00 |
| Baru | P 200.00 |
| Sapiao | P 200.00 |
| Salambao | P 100.00 |

### Auxiliary Invoice Fees (per Section 15, R.A. 8550):

| Item | Fee |
|------|-----|
| Mga preserbadong isda (dried, fermented, etc.) | P 100.00 |
| Guinamos/Bagoong | P 100.00 |
| Halintuyong Balatan | P 150.00 |
| Semilya ng Bangus | P 20.00/1,000 pcs |

**Section 4 — Use of Municipal Waters.** The Municipal Government, cooperatives, and registered entities may use the waters. Those registered in the list of beneficiaries or with a license or permit shall be given priority. Outsiders from Pitogo, Quezon may be permitted but must comply with all requirements and have no pending criminal cases.

**Section 5 — Supervision and Enforcement.** The Municipal Mayor, through the Pitogo Municipal Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Management Council (FARMC), shall oversee and enforce this ordinance.

### Fish Sanctuary Zones:

**A. For Bangus (Milkfish) Culture:**
- Zone 1: Center of river at Brgy. Cabulihan extending to Brgy. Sunog Waste
- Zone 2: Sunog Waste extending to Brgy. Sunog Late
- Zone 3: Brgy. Sunog Late extending to Brgy. Nag-Cruz
- Zone 4: Brgy. Nag-Cruz extending to Brgy. Sentro (center of river)

**B. For Tahong (Mussel) Culture:**
- Zone 5: Center of river at Sunog Waste extending to Sunog Late
- Zone 6: Brgy. Nag-Cruz extending to Brgy. Soliyao

**C. For Talaba (Oyster) Culture:**
- Zone 7: Center of river at Gawayan River
- Zone 8: Eastern area of Gawayan River

**D. For Construction of Fish Corrals and Other Uses:**
- Zone 9: Center of river at Brgy. Cabulihan (10 hectares minimum)
- Zone 10: Eastern section of Brgy. Sunog Waste
- Zone 11: Eastern area extending to Bayabos River
- Zone 12: Center of river extending east to Bayabos River (declared as reserve area for the poblacion)

**Section 6 — Fees and Charges (Exclusive Rights).**
The [[Sangguniang Bayan]] may grant exclusive rights for fishery, aquaculture, or related activities within designated zones. Fees based on area:

| Zone | Fee |
|------|-----|
| Zone 1: Below 3 meters (tatlong metro ang lalin) | P 250.00 per year |
| Zone 2: 3 to 5 meters deep | P 300.00 |
| Zone 3: 5 meters or more (kulonganin sa walong metrong lalin) | P 400.00 |
| Zone 4: 8 meters or more (kulonganin sa sampo/10 metrong lalin) | P 500.00 |
| Zone 5: 1,000 to 5,000 sq. meters | P 1.00 per sq. meter |
| Zone 6: 5,000+ sq. meters to 10,000 sq. meters | P 1.00 per sq. meter |
| Zone 7: Below 1,000 sq. meters | P 1.00 per sq. meter |
| Zone 8: 1,000 to 5,000 sq. meters | P 1.00 per sq. meter |
| Zone 9: Below 2,000 sq. meters | P 0.50 per sq. meter |
| Zone 10: 2,000 to 4,000 sq. meters | P 0.50 per sq. meter |
| Zone 11: 4,000 to 8,000 sq. meters | P 0.50 per sq. meter |
| Zone 12: 8,000 sq. meters or more | P 0.50 per sq. meter |

**Section 7 — Prohibited Methods.** The following fishing methods and activities are strictly prohibited in the municipal waters of Pitogo:
- Trawl (malaki man o maliit)
- Buli-buli (malaki man o maliit)
- Dinamita and other explosive devices for fishing
- Use of fine-meshed nets (pagkilamon at iba pang kauri nito)
- Lanyeros (fine-meshed seine nets below 3 cm mesh)
- Kayakos
- Kapasira
- Katalay
- Pangingisuriyente (electro fishing)
- Use of noxious or poisonous substances (active gear)
- Use of bottom-set gill nets smaller than certain mesh sizes (as specified)
- Catching immature fish (maliit at maliit, not yet matured or small but matured already) similar to siganid, silao, dalong, and other similar species
- Dynamite and similar explosive fishing methods
- Fishing at prohibited times and in designated fish sanctuary areas
- Gathering and destroying corals
- Gathering, handling, or disturbing marine turtles
- Destruction and disposal of waste, oil, chemicals near fishing grounds and at the place within the municipality
- Gathering, handling, and trading of species covered by CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora)

**Section 8 — Authorized Enforcement.** The Punong Bayan (Mayor), with the assistance of the barangay officials, PNP Maritime Command, PNP Coast Guard, Philippine Coast Guard, FHP Community at Deputy Fish Warden, are jointly authorized to implement this ordinance. Violators shall be issued a "Deputation Order."

**Section 9 — Deputy Fish Warden.** Authorized enforcement officers shall be issued a Deputation Order and may confiscate any fishing equipment used in violation, and offenders shall be fined Three Hundred Fifty-Six Pesos (P 356.00) as a penalty.

**Section 10 — Penalties.** Any person violating this ordinance shall be punished as follows:
- Fine of not less than Two Thousand Pesos (P 2,000.00) and not exceeding Twenty-Five Thousand Pesos (P 25,000.00)
- Imprisonment of not less than four (4) months and not exceeding six (6) months, or both, at the discretion of the court

**Section 11 — Subsidiary Laws.** Matters not covered by this ordinance shall be governed by RA 8550 (Philippine Fisheries Code of 1998) and [[RA-7160|R.A. 7160]].

**Section 12 — Separability Clause.** If any provision of this ordinance is declared invalid, the remaining provisions shall continue to be valid and enforceable.

**Section 13 — Effectivity.** The ordinance requires approval of the Punong Bayan and the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, with posting for ten (10) consecutive days in at least four (4) conspicuous places within the municipality and in two (2) prominent locations in each barangay.
